questions.question: How much lower is the average review score for delivered orders that arrived late than for delivered orders that arrived on time?
questions.sql:
WITH delivered AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         (o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS is_late
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
), scored AS (
  SELECT d.is_late, r.review_score
  FROM delivered d
  JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = d.order_id
)
SELECT round(avg(review_score) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_late), 2) AS on_time_avg_score,
       round(avg(review_score) FILTER (WHERE is_late), 2) AS late_avg_score,
       round((avg(review_score) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_late) - avg(review_score) FILTER (WHERE is_late))::numeric, 2) AS score_gap
FROM scored
questions.note: The gap is on-time minus late, so a positive value means late orders score lower. Scores are averaged over the review rows of each delivered order, following the per-order convention, so a review that covers several orders counts once per order.
